provenance.asset_description: Akiton View, artist Pixoloid Studios: A glimpse of the city of Maro, where buildings and skyscrapers climb the walls of a deep and narrow canyon. The city is cast in near eternal twilight thanks to the shadows of the canyon’s walls, and lit by countless neon lights, holo ads, and streetlamps.
